originality.rationale: FAIL: The November 2 2026 published Delannoy theorem already establishes v2(D_m-1)=3v2(m) on every positive m divisible by four, and its proof establishes an analytic 2-adic interpolation F(m)=sum_j 2^j binom(m,j)^2 with uniform coefficient control on m in 4Z_2. For every odd n≡3 mod4, m=-n-1 belongs to 4Z_2; the classical hypergeometric/Legendre parity transformation gives F(-n-1)=(-1)^n D_n=-D_n, and v2(m)=v2(n+1)=v2(n(n+1)). By density of positive 4-divisible integers and continuity/constant valuation on each open nonzero 2-adic stratum, the published sharp formula extends to m=-n-1. Its t=1 cases follow by elementary mod8. Thus the new all-index alternating-sign law is a corollary of the earlier sharp even-index theorem plus standard 2-adic interpolation, with the same quadratic/cubic cancellation mechanism. The restricted cubic-contact description is likewise implied by the prior proof’s uniform coefficient parity bounds after x=4Y, not an independently motivated new invariant.
